People like to feel better about themselves by attacking others.  Many situations are 'damned if you do, damned if you don't', where regardless of your actions you're going to do something that someone finds upsetting.  In this case, you're either a "racist" or a "bloody fool".  I realize this situation is different, but I went to a place of business a few months back and there were two people behind the counter, both available to help me.  One was a white woman, the other was a black man.  I realized regardless of which one I went to, the other could take that as a microaggression against them.  Either I'm subtly racist for choosing the white, or I'm subtly sexist for choosing the man.  Sometimes no matter what you're gonna take heat.

Just consider for a moment that our societal acceptance of marijuana is growing and before too long it will be legal on a nationwide scale.  With the legalization will come more restrictions governing our behavior while intoxicated with the drug.  Driving while high is akin to driving drunk in Canada.  It's still a form of mind altering intoxication.  Now consider how slow our legal system moves in comparison to our always changing social mores and values.  Our concepts of consent have changed greatly over the last 20 years.  It's totally possible in the future marijuana will be treated similarly to alcohol in regard to ability to consent.  It's crazy to think about.
